record.question: As per _________"cognizable offence" means an offence for which, and "cognizable case" means a case in which, a police officer may, in accordance with the First Schedule or under any other law for the time being in force, arrest without warrant;
record.explanation: Under the BNSS, cognizable offence is defined in Section 2(1)(d).
